clear.name: Clear Weather
clear.description: Removes all Weather Cards (Biting Frost, Impenetrable Fog and Torrential Rain) effects.

frost.name: Biting Frost
frost.description: Sets the strength of all Close Combat cards to 1 for both players.

white_frost.name: White Frost
white_frost.description: Sets the strength of all cards on the 2 corresponding rows to 1 for both players.

fog.name: Impenetrable Fog
fog.description: Sets the strength of all Ranged Combat cards to 1 for both players.

fog_summoning.name: Impenetrable Fog Summoning
fog_summoning.description: When Impenetrable Fog is played by any player, draw this card from your deck or discard pile and play it. Fog does not affect this unit.

rain.name: Torrential Rain
rain.description: Sets the strength of all Siege Combat cards to 1 for both players.

storm.name: Skellige Storm
storm.description: Reduces to 1 the strength of all units either in Close/Ranged rows, or Siege/Ranged rows.

sandstorm.name: Sandstorm
sandstorm.description: Reduces the Strength of all Close Combat and Ranged Combat Units to 1 (non-Hero units only).

sandstorm_immunity.name: Sandstorm Inmunity
sandstorm_immunity.description: Sandstorm does not affect this unit.

spider_web.name: Giant Spider Webs
spider_web.description: Sets the strength of all Close Combat cards to 1 for both players.

tse_tse.name: Tse Tse Flies
tse_tse.description: Sets the strength of all Ranged Combat cards to 1 for both players.

dragon_wrath.name: Dragon Wrath
dragon_wrath.description: Sets the strength of all Siege Combat cards to 1 for both players.

hero.name: Hero
hero.description: Not affected by any Special Cards or abilities.

decoy.name: Decoy
decoy.description: Swap with a card on the battlefield to return it to your hand.

horn.name: Commander's Horn
horn.description: Doubles the strength of all unit cards in that row. Limited to 1 per row.

mardroeme.name: Mardroeme
mardroeme.description: Triggers transformation of all Berserker cards on the same row.

berserker.name: Berserker
berserker.description: Transforms into a bear when a Mardroeme card is on its row.

scorch.name: Scorch
scorch.description: Discard after playing. Kills the strongest card(s) on the battlefield.

scorch_c.name: Scorch Close
scorch_c.description: Destroy your enemy's strongest Close Combat unit(s) if the combined strength of all his or her Close Combat units is 10 or more.

scorch_r.name: Scorch Ranged
scorch_r.description: Destroy your enemy's strongest Ranged Combat unit(s) if the combined strength of all his or her Ranged Combat units is 10 or more.

scorch_s.name: Scorch Siege
scorch_s.description: Destroys your enemy's strongest Siege Combat unit(s) if the combined strength of all his or her Siege Combat units is 10 or more.

cull.name: Cull
cull.description: Kills the weakest card(s) on the battlefield.

agile.name: Agile
agile.description: Can be placed in either the Close Combat or the Ranged Combat row. Cannot be moved once placed.

agile_cr.name: Agile Close/Ranged
agile_cr.description: Can be placed in either the Close Combat or the Ranged Combat row. Cannot be moved once placed.

agile_cs.name: Agile Close/Siege
agile_cs.description: Can be placed in either the Close Combat or the Siege Combat row. Cannot be moved once placed.

agile_rs.name: Agile Ranged/Siege
agile_rs.description: Can be placed in either the Ranged Combat or the Siege Combat row. Cannot be moved once placed.

agile_crs.name: Agile Close/Ranged/Siege
agile_crs.description: Can be placed in any combat row. Cannot be moved once placed.

muster.name: Muster
muster.description: Find any cards with the same name in your deck and play them instantly.

spy.name: Spy
spy.description: Place on your opponent's battlefield (counts towards your opponent's total) and draw 2 cards from your deck.
spy.description_toussaint: Place on your opponent's battlefield. Draw 3 cards from your deck. Keep one of them in your hand and shuffle the other two into the deck.

medic.name: Medic
medic.description: Choose one card from your discard pile and play it instantly (no Heroes or Special Cards).

morale.name: Morale Boost
morale.description: Adds +1 to all units in the row (excluding itself).

bond.name: Tight Bond
bond.description: Place next to a card with the same name to double the strength of both cards.

avenger.name: Avenger
avenger.description: When this card is removed from the battlefield, it summons a powerful new Unit Card to take its place.

cintra_slaughter.name: Slaughter of Cintra
cintra_slaughter.description: When using the Slaugther of Cintra special card, destroy all units on your side of the board having the Slaughter of Cintra ability then draw as many cards as units destroyed.

foltest_king.description: Pick an Impenetrable Fog or Torrential Rain card from your deck and play it instantly.

foltest_lord.description: Clear any weather effects (resulting from Biting Frost, Torrential Rain or Impenetrable Fog cards) in play.

foltest_siegemaster.description: Doubles the strength of all your Siege units (unless a Commander's Horn is also present on that row).

foltest_steelforged.description: Destroy your enemy's strongest Siege unit(s) if the combined strength of all his or her Siege units is 10 or more.

foltest_son.description: Destroy your enemy's strongest Ranged Combat unit(s) if the combined strength of all his or her Ranged Combat units is 10 or more.

emhyr_imperial.description: Draw an opponent's discarded non-hero unit into your hand. Then put any card from your hand on the bottom of your deck.

emhyr_emperor.description: Look at 4 random cards in your opponent's hand. Choose one. Opponent must play this card on his next turn (if he does not fold).

emhyr_whiteflame.description: Passive: When using Spies or Emissaries, you may draw cards from your opponent's deck instead of your own (max 3 cards per battle).

emhyr_relentless.description: Destroy one unit or hero card on your battlefield. Then draw any one Spy or Emissary card from your deck into your hand.

emhyr_invader.description: Play a unit or hero card from each player's discard pile onto their respective side of the field.

eredin_bringer_of_death.name: Eredin : Bringer of Death
eredin_bringer_of_death.description: Restore a unit card from your discard pile to your hand.

eredin_destroyer.description: Discard 2 cards and draw 1 card of your choice from your deck.

eredin_king.description: Pick any weather card from your deck and play it instantly.

eredin_treacherous.description: Doubles the strength of all spy cards (affects both players).

francesca_queen.description: Destroy your enemy's strongest Close Combat unit(s) if the combined strength of all his or her Close Combat units is 10 or more.

francesca_beautiful.description: Doubles the strength of all your Ranged Combat units (unless a Commander's Horn is also present on that row).

francesca_daisy.description: At the start of the game, draw 13 cards. Choose 2 and shuffle them into your deck to start with an 11-card hand.

francesca_pureblood.description: Choose 3 or less unit and/or hero cards, which lie on the opponent's battlefield. Move these cards to any other opponent's row (rows).

francesca_hope.description: Choose 4 or less unit and/or hero cards, which lie on your battlefield. Move these cards to your any other row (rows).

crach_an_craite.description: Shuffle all cards from each player's graveyard back into their decks. You can keep one of the cards in the graveyard.

king_bran.description: Once per game, at the start of any round: draw a Skellige Storm from your deck. This round, halve all weather effects on your cards.

birna.description: Draw from your deck any card with Mardroeme or Werewolf ability. Units are played immediately, specials are added to your hand.

madman_lugos.description: Once per game at the beginning of any round your opponent must show you 2 random cards in his hand. Pick one of them and discard it.

holger_blakhand.description: Set a card's strength up to 10. Resets after round. (2 uses/battle).

radovid_king_redania.description: Draw three cards from your deck (excluding special cards, spies, and envoys). Play one of them immediately, shuffle the other two back into the deck.

radovid_mad_king.description: Destroy the strongest card on the battlefield (it must be a unit or a hero). If there are several strongest cards, choose and destroy only one of them.

radovid_strategist.description: Choose one hero card on your battlefield. Take it back to your hand.

anna_henrietta_duchess.description: Pick one hero card from your grave and play it immediately.

anna_henrietta_ladyship.description: Choose a second-form Toussaint Monster on the battlefield to play its weaker form. You can transform it back later.

anna_henrietta_little_weasel.description: Choose an enemy hero card and remove its Hero status.

lady_wood_whispess.description: Take from your discard pile in your hand 3 or less unit cards, that died in the current round.

lady_wood_brewess.description: When your faction ability triggers: draw 2 cards instead of 1. Play one and shuffle the other back into your deck.

lady_wood_weavess.description: Draw a Curse card from your deck and play it immediatly.

ghost_tree.description: Destroy the weakest unit card on the battlefield (any player). If there are several, choose one.

eredin_commander.description: Choose on your battlefield two or less unit and/or hero cards and take them into your hand.

auberon_king.description: Draw from your deck or graveyard any number of Navigator cards. Then choose in your hand the same number of cards and put them back in any place of the deck.

winter_queen.description: Draw any special card from your deck and play it immediatly.

caranthir_navigator.description: You can open two Dimensional Doors at the same time (but only if there is at least one navigator in each of these 2 rows).

imlerith_general.description: Passive: Imlerith will shield Navigators from destruction.

queen_calanthe.description: Play a unit then draw a card from you deck.

fake_ciri.description: Discard a card from your hand and then draw two cards from your deck.

radovid_stern.description: Discard 2 cards and draw 1 card of your choice from your deck.

radovid_ruthless.description: Cancel the scorch ability for one round

vilgefortz_magician_kovir.description: Halves the strength of all spy cards (affects both players).

cosimo_malaspina.description: Destroy your enemy's strongest Melee unit(s) if the combined strength of all his or her Melee units is 10 or more.

resilience.name: Resilience
resilience.description: Stays on the board next round if another allied unit has an ability in common.

witcher_wolf_school.name: Wolf School
witcher_wolf_school.description: Boost each unit of this school by 2 for each card of the same school.

witcher_viper_school.name: Viper School
witcher_viper_school.description: Boost each unit of this school by 2 for each card of the same school.

witcher_bear_school.name: Bear School
witcher_bear_school.description: Boost each unit of this school by 2 for each card of the same school.

witcher_cat_school.name: Cat School
witcher_cat_school.description: Boost each unit of this school by 2 for each card of the same school.

witcher_griffin_school.name: Griffin School
witcher_griffin_school.description: Boost each unit of this school by 2 for each card of the same school.

shield.name: Shield
shield.description: Protects units in the row from all abilities except weather effects.

seize.name: Seize
seize.description: Move the Melee unit(s) with the lowest strength on your side of the board/ Their abilities won't work anymore.

lock.name: Lock
lock.description: Lock/cancels the ability of the next unit played in that row (ignores units without abilities and heroes).

knockback.name: Knockback
knockback.description: Pushes all units of the selected row (Melee or Ranged) or row back towards the Siege row, ignores shields.

alzur_maker.description: Destroy one of your units on the board and summon a Koshchey.

vilgefortz_sorcerer.description: Clear all weather effects in play.

toussaint_wine.name: Toussaint Wine
toussaint_wine.description: Placed on Melee or Ranged row, boosts all units of the selected row by two. Limited to one per row.

meve_princess.description: If the opponent has a total of 10 or higher on one row, destroy that row's strongest card(s) (affects only the opponent's side of the battle field).

shield_c.name: Melee Shield
shield_c.description: Protects units in the Melee row from all abilities except weather effects.

shield_r.name: Ranged Shield
shield_r.description: Protects units in the Ranged row from all abilities except weather effects.

shield_s.name: Siege Shield
shield_s.description: Protects units in the Siege row from all abilities except weather effects.

meve_white_queen.description: All medic cards can choose two unit cards from the discard pile (affects both players).

carlo_varese.description: If the opponent has a total of 10 or higher on one row, destroy that row's strongest card(s) (affects only the opponent's side of the battle field).

francis_bedlam.description: Send all spy unit cards to the grave of the side they are on.

cyprian_wiley.description: Seize the unit(s) with the lowest strength of the opponents melee row.

cyrus_hemmelfart.description: Play a Dimeritum Shackles card in any of the opponent's row.

cyrus_hemmelfart1.description: Once per game: Play an Inquisitional Pyres card on the appropriate row.

azar_javed.description: Destroy the enemy's weakest hero card (max 1 card).

bank.name: Bank
bank.description: Draw a card from your deck.

witch_hunt.name: Witch Hunt
witch_hunt.description: Destroy the weakest unit on the opposite row. If there are several, choose one.

zerrikanterment.description: Amount of worshippers boost is doubled.

baal_zebuth.description: Select 2 cards from your opponent's discard pile and shuffle them back into his/her deck.

rarog.description: Draw a random card from the discard pile to your hand (any card) and then shuffle the rest back into the deck.

whorshipper.name: Whorshipper
whorshipper.description: Boost by 1 all whorshipped units on your side of the board.

whorshipped.name: Whorshipped
whorshipped.description: Boosted by 1 by all whorshippers present on your side of the board.

inspire.name: Inspire
inspire.description: All units with Inspire ability take the highest base strength of the Inspire units on your side of the board. Still affected by weather.

comrade.name: Comrade
comrade.description: Once per round, this card can prevent the destruction of another card on its side of the board, including itself.

invoke.name: Invoke
invoke.description: Invokes one of the available associated cards from the deck.

emissary.name: Emissary
emissary.description: Place on your opponent's battlefield (counts towards your opponent's total), either draw one card or look first 4 and put them back in order of choice, Once per round, some of these can be placed at the bottom.

necrophage.name: Necrophage
necrophage.description: Choose up to 2 unit cards from your discard pile and shuffle them back into your deck.

goetia.name: Goetia
goetia.description: Place on your battlefield and take 1 card from your deck to your hand, then choose any 1 card from your hand and shuffle it into your deck.

ambush.name: Ambush
ambush.description: Place on any row. If the opponent plays a unit or hero on this row, draw 2 cards and send this card to the discard pile

skellige_fleet.name: Skellige Fleet
skellige_fleet.description: Place on your battlefield and either draw from your deck 1 top card instantly OR draw 2 top cards at the end of this round. In one round you can draw by Skellige Fleet no more than 3 cards.

summon_one_of.name: Summon One Of
summon_one_of.description: Summons from anywhere (deck, grave or hand) one of the associated card of choice

immortal.name: Immortal
immortal.description: Card stays on the battlefield for 2 rounds and cannot be destroyed by another ability

monster_toussaint.name: Monster of Toussaint
monster_toussaint.description: From the next turn onward you can discard this card from the board to instantly play its second strongest form.

aerondight.name: Aerondight
aerondight.description: Place this card on the board, then move the unit with the highest original strength to the siege row. While there, triple its strength.

bait.name: Bait
bait.description: Place on your battlefield and draw from your deck one card with Tight Bond ability. Play it immediatly.

soothsayer.name: Soothsayer
soothsayer.description: Place on your battlefield. For each soothsayer card on your side of the battlefield, you can draw one more card to choose from.

curse.name: Curse
curse.description: Place on your or opponent's battlefield on any row. Next unit card (not hero) that will be placed on this row will be destroyed and it's abilities will not work

door.name: Dimensional Door
door.description: While the door is active, at the end of each of your turns you should draw one card from your deck. If the row of the card matches the row of the door, play it immediatly, otherwise put it back into the deck. If it does not have a row, you can play it or put it back into the deck.

door_o.name: Dimensional Door Opening
door_o.description: Opens the dimensional door of the row it is in, if none other is opened

sage.name: Sage
sage.description: Place on your battlefield and draw 4 cards from your deck. Look at them and put them back at the top or bottom of the deck in the order of your choice.

zirael.name: Zirael
zirael.description: Place on your battlefield. Reveal 5 cards from your deck and choose up to 2 to add to your hand. Shuffle the rest back into the deck.

naglfar.name: Naglfar
naglfar.description: Place on your battlefield and draw 2 cards or less from your deck with the word 'Naglfar' in their name and play them immediatly.

omen.name: Omen
omen.description: Create a copy of Cat and Dog and add it to your hand.

trade.name: Trade
trade.description: Choose 1 card from the enemy's deck. Trade 1 of your runes from your deck to their hand.

adaptive.name: Adaptive
adaptive.description: When affected by Weather, this unit's base Strength is 2 (not 1).

morale_c.name: Close Combat Morale Boost
morale_c.description: Grants a morale boost to the Close Combat row from the special slot.

morale_r.name: Ranged Combat Morale Boost
morale_r.description: Grants a morale boost to the Ranged Combat row from the special slot.

morale_s.name: Siege Combat Morale Boost
morale_s.description: Grants a morale boost to the Siege row from the special slot.

ofiri_envoy.name: Ofiri Envoy
ofiri_envoy.description: Place on the opponent's field. Draw 1 card from the opponent's deck and 1 from yours, or draw 2 cards from your deck.

ofir_aamad.name: Aamad, the Wise
ofir_aamad.description: Whenever you draw a card, you gain +1 total power for this round permanently (resets upon round completion back to 0).

nibras.description: Draw 3 cards from your deck, except special cards, spies, or envoys. Play one and shuffle the other 2 back into your deck.

ofir_aamad_crown.description: Starts the game with Ofieri Prince on the board.

nibras_gale.description: Once per game, you may look at the top 3 cards of your opponent's deck. Add one to your hand and put the remaining cards into their discard pile.

chernobog.name: Chernobog
chernobog.description: Double the strength of any unit card in your Close combat row. Discard after playing.

perun.name: Perun
perun.description: Add +5 strength to any unit card in your Ranged row. Discard after playing.

triglav.name: Triglav's Weaken
triglav.description: Choose an enemy hero card and weaken it by removing its Hero status. Discard after playing.

veles.name: Veles
veles.description: Move your strongest unit card to the Siege row. While there, its strength is doubled. Discard after playing.

morana.name: Morana
morana.description: Choose an enemy unit in the Close row and reduce its strength to 1. Discard after playing.

svarog.name: Svarog
svarog.description: Choose an enemy unit in the Siege row and reduce its strength to 1. Discard after playing.

devana.name: Devana's Hunt
devana.description: Reduce the strength of all non-hero enemy units in the Ranged row to 2. Discard after playing.

zoria.name: Zoria's Frost
zoria.description: Freeze the opponent's Close combat row. Discard after playing.

stribog.name: Stribog
stribog.description: Move the enemy Ranged unit(s) with the lowest strength to your side of the board. Discard after playing.

rune_call.name: Rune Crafting
rune_call.description: Choose and add a Rune card from your deck to your hand.

clairvoyance.name: Clairvoyance
clairvoyance.description: Choose to either look at the top 3 cards of your deck OR look at 3 random cards in your opponent's hand.

wish1.name: Malicious Wish 1
wish1.description: Choose 1 of 3 random cards from the enemy hand. Cost: Destroy your strongest non-hero unit (Strength ≥ 6).

wish2.name: Malicious Wish 2
wish2.description: Choose 1 of the top 3 cards from your deck. Cost: Destroy your strongest non-hero unit (Strength ≥ 6). This card is immune.

wish3.name: Malicious Wish 3
wish3.description: Destroy 1 non-hero enemy unit. Cost: Destroy your strongest non-hero unit (Strength ≥ 7). This card is immune.

doppler.name: Doppler
doppler.description: Choose an enemy unit (not hero or special) from the opposite row and transform into a basic copy of it (stats only, no abilities).

decoration.name: Decoration
decoration.description: Promote a friendly unit to Hero status

novigrad_sigismund.name: Sigismund Dijkstra
novigrad_sigismund.description: Once per game, prevent the first death of a friendly unit.

novigrad_sigismund2.name: Sigismund Dijkstra
novigrad_sigismund2.description: If an opponent plays a spy on you, draw 1 card.
